summary_1line: Vaisampayana begins recounting cosmic genealogies from Brahma through Kasyapa and Daksha’s daughters, describing the origins of gods, Asuras, serpents, Gandharvas, and Apsaras.

image_candidates.scene_text: Indra stands in Narayana’s celestial abode consulting him while the assembled gods prepare to descend to earth.
Garuda, mighty and radiant, rises beside his brother Aruna while the serpent sons of Kadru coil below.
Rahu lunges upward in the sky attempting to seize the Sun and Moon.
